title: Tip from Angela - Sleep is My Secret Weapon
summary: A wellbeing tip arguing that adequate sleep improves learning, creativity and retention more than staying up late to grind.

concepts.heading: Key takeaways
points: Sleep deprivation is not a badge of seriousness: routine skills survive it, but creative thinking, new learning and making connections suffer.
Sleep helps the brain clear daytime by-products and consolidate what was learned, so cramming without sleep tends not to stick.

Practical habits mentioned: set an alarm to start winding down about an hour before bed, switch screens off, use red-tinted glasses if screens are unavoidable, read fiction, have a warm drink or small snack.
Keep a regular sleep rhythm so the next day starts fresh.
No supplement or medication replaces good sleep.
